gallery.title: Premium Flat-Bottom Side Gusset Coffee Bags
gallery.desc: Flat-bottom side gusset coffee bags with triple-sealed gussets for stable standing and full-panel branding. Multi-layer kraft or matte PET/AL/PE with a one-way degassing valve and high-barrier liner to lock in aroma. Custom printing, lamination and embossing available.
gallery.content:
**Built to Protect. Designed to Sell.**

Give your coffee the packaging it deserves. Our flat-bottom side gusset bags pair strong multi-layer barriers with a clean, premium look — keeping whole bean and ground coffee fresh while making your brand stand out on shelf.

**Smart Structure**

Triple-sealed side gussets expand capacity and give the bag a stable, upright base. The flat bottom sits firmly on any shelf, and the front, back and gusset panels give you generous space for your logo and artwork.

**Freshness You Can Trust**

Choose natural kraft paper (Kraft/PET/PE) or matte-finish PET/AL/PE. A one-way degassing valve releases CO₂ without letting oxygen in, while the heat-sealable inner liner blocks oxygen, moisture, UV light and odors — locking in aroma from roastery to cup.

**Made Yours**

Finish it your way: eco-friendly printing, matte or gloss lamination, or embossing for a premium tactile feel. Low MOQ and fast sampling available — send us your artwork and we will help with the dieline.

gallery.title: Flat-bottom gusset coffee bags with a resealable tin tie
gallery.desc: kraft or foil, custom printed, with an optional one-way valve to keep beans fresh. Low MOQ and fast sampling.
gallery.content:
Flat-bottom gusset coffee bags with a tin tie, made to your exact requirements — size, material, printing, thickness and packing details are all tailored to your needs. Every bag can be finished with a one-way degassing valve, a resealable tin tie or an easy-tear notch.

**Why Choose These Bags**

**One-Way Degassing Valve**
The one-way valve lets CO₂ escape from freshly roasted beans while keeping outside air out, so roasters can pack coffee right away without the risk of bursting.

**Resealable Tin Tie**
The sticky tin strips are easy to open and close, and the adhesive is strong enough to keep beans fresh between uses — saving time and trouble.

**Easy-Tear Notch**
A precise tear notch makes the bag easy to open by hand. The film stays strong in transit, and the top can be re-sealed with a sealing machine after opening.

**VMPET Barrier**
The metallised PET layer resists moisture and effectively prevents liquid penetration, protecting flavour and aroma.

gallery.desc: Eight-side seal box pouch coffee bags with an optional one-way degassing valve — 12+ colours, sizes from 125g to 1kg, food-grade multi-layer film. Ready stock, low MOQ and free design support.
gallery.content:
**Eight-Side Seal Coffee Bags with Optional Degassing Valve**

Meet the pouch that stands out on shelf. Our eight-side seal coffee bags have a structured, square base that keeps the bag upright and gives your brand five printable panels — front, back, two sides and base. Available in over a dozen colours and a full range of sizes, with or without a one-way degassing valve.

**Eight-Side Seal (Box Pouch)**​
Unlike a standard stand-up pouch, the eight-side seal construction creates a rigid, cube-like shape. It sits firmly on the shelf, maximises branding space on every face, and helps protect coffee beans from being crushed in transit.

**Optional One-Way Degassing Valve**
Choose the valve version if you pack freshly roasted beans — it releases CO₂ while keeping outside air out, so the coffee stays fresh and the bag won't swell. Prefer a cleaner look? The no-valve version is equally available.

**Multi-Layer Barrier**
Made from MOPP/VMPET/PE (BOPP/VMPET/CPP also available), the laminated film resists moisture, oxygen and light, locking in aroma from roastery to cup.

**Ready Stock in 12+ Colours**
Red, green, black, gold, pink, white, light blue, kraft, emerald green, orange, avocado green and silver — plus two-tone options with a white body and orange or blue sides. Stock colours are dispatched within 48 hours.

**Sizes for Every Need**
From a 125g sample size to a 1kg family pack, in both flat-bottom and vertical formats. Need a custom size? Send us your dimensions and we will make it to order.

**Custom Printing**
Add your logo and artwork in vibrant printing. Our in-house designers help you finish the artwork for free — just send your logo and layout in PDF, PSD or AI.

gallery.content:
**Kraft Paper Coffee Bags with Insert Card**

Bring a natural, minimal look to your coffee with our kraft paper bags — made for roasters who want their packaging to feel as good as the coffee inside. Choose white or natural brown kraft, add your own insert card, and finish with printing that makes your brand unmistakable.

**Insert Card Slot**
A built-in slot holds a separate card — perfect for showing your coffee name, origin, roast level or a short story. Swap the card anytime without changing the bag, ideal for rotating single origins or seasonal blends.

**Two Bag Styles**
Pick the shape that fits your shelf:
• Stand-up pouch with a gusseted base — classic, space-efficient
• Eight-side seal box pouch — cube-like, stands firm, 5 printable faces

**Resealable Zipper & Optional Valve**
A press-to-close zipper keeps coffee fresh after opening. Add a one-way degassing valve for freshly roasted beans — it releases CO₂ while keeping outside air out.

**Food-Grade Kraft Barrier**
Made from kraft paper / NY / PE with a double-layer structure, the bag resists moisture and is hygienic for direct food contact — protecting aroma and keeping beans crisp.

**Finishing Options**
Make it yours with colour printing, UV spot finish or hot-stamp foil. Add a card in white or natural kraft to match your brand.

gallery.desc: Eye-catching holographic and rainbow film coffee bags in an eight-side seal box pouch — thickened, water & moisture resistant, with or without a one-way valve. Custom logo printing and flexible sizes.
gallery.content:
**Holographic Eight-Side Seal Coffee Bags with Optional Valve**

Put your brand in the spotlight. These holographic coffee bags catch the light from every angle, turning an ordinary shelf into an eye-catching display — while a rigid box-pouch base keeps the bag standing tall and the contents protected.

**Iridescent Holographic & Rainbow Film**
Choose from a holographic laser film or a clear rainbow film finish. Both shift and shimmer as the light moves, giving your packaging a premium, high-impact look that a standard matte bag simply cannot match. Available in vertical laser, cube laser, cube rainbow and vertical rainbow styles.

**Eight-Side Seal Box Pouch**
The eight-side seal construction creates a structured, square base that stands firmly on the shelf. Front, back, two side panels and the base give you generous space for your logo and artwork, and the rigid shape helps protect beans from being crushed in transit.

**Thickened, Water & Moisture Resistant**
Made from PE / clear rainbow film or PE/PET holographic laser film with a thickened structure. The film resists water and moisture, helping keep coffee, tea and dried food fresh and crisp on the shelf.

**Optional One-Way Degassing Valve**
Packing freshly roasted beans? Add a one-way valve to release CO₂ while keeping outside air out — no swollen bags, no lost aroma. Prefer a cleaner finish? A no-valve version is available too.

**Stock Sizes and Custom Options**
Ready sizes cover 1/4 lb, 1/2 lb, 1 lb and 2 lb, in both compact and tall formats. Need something different? Send us your dimensions and we will make the bag to order. Add your logo with custom printing — we help finish the artwork.
